Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 7th February, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-67/Law/81/Vol.
II, dated 7-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 2nd February, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Finance
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on the 1st day of July, 2000.

Omission of sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 11 and 12 of Act IV of 1996

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 7th February, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-67/Law/81/Vol.
II, dated 7-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 2nd February, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Omission of sections 3, 4,
7, 8, 11 and 12 of Act IV of 1996.---In the Balochistan Finance Act, 1996,
sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 11 and 12, shall be omitted.
